images.prompt: One simple dark red city bicycle with two wheels, a curved handlebar and a small brown saddle standing in full side profile against a plain warm white wall. Photorealistic camera photograph of a fictional independently generated scene. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280 or larger. Natural material and light. No artwork, text, brands, logos, borders or watermark.

review.reason: One complete recognizable city bicycle with two wheels, connected frame, saddle and curved handlebars provides clear structural junctions for thread reconstruction; no cropped primary parts.

images.actual_source_analysis: One burgundy step-through city bicycle is shown in complete side profile facing right against a warm cream wall. Both spoked wheels, open curved frame, rear luggage rack, full mudguards, brown saddle, silver curved handlebar with brown grip and bell, brake cables, chain guard and one near pedal are visible. The wheels rest on pale stone paving under soft sunlight; no person or readable brand appears.
